html:
Panama is the narrow country that joins Central and South America, and the site of the Panama Canal. It has been independent since 1903.

The isthmus has always been a crossing point. In 1513 Vasco Núñez de Balboa crossed it and became the first European to see the Pacific from the Americas. Peruvian silver was carried overland from Panama City to the Caribbean for the Spanish treasure fleet. After independence from Spain in 1821, Panama was part of Colombia. The Panama Railroad, finished in 1855, carried gold seekers bound for California.

A French company led by Ferdinand de Lesseps, builder of the Suez Canal, began a canal in 1881 but gave up after disease killed many thousands of workers. When Colombia refused American terms, the United States backed Panama's breakaway in 1903. The new state gave the United States control of a Canal Zone, and the canal opened in 1914.

The Canal Zone was a sore point for decades. Under the Torrijos-Carter Treaties of 1977 the United States agreed to hand over the canal. Before that happened, the military ruler Manuel Noriega fell out with Washington, and the American invasion of December 1989 removed him. Panama took over the canal on 31 December 1999 and finished the canal's expansion in 2016. It has also become a centre of banking and ship registration.
sum: Panama is the narrow country that joins Central and South America, and the site of the Panama Canal. It has been independent since 1903.
